## Summary

- **`crates/hh-bundle/src/foreign.rs` (new)** — the closed `ForeignFormat`
  sum (`harbor_trial_dir`, `harbor_job_dir`, `interchange_trajectory`,
  `swebench_submission`, `inspect_eval_log`, `in_toto_bundle`,
  `telemetry_trace`); `parse` is the one grammar (CC1) — outside spellings
  refuse `FormatUnknown`, never guess; a known format asked the wrong
  direction refuses the new typed `BundleError::ForeignDirectionRefused`
  (`interchange_trajectory` at `import` — OQ-030/ADR-0213 stays parked;
  `harbor_trial_dir` at `export`).
- **Four lifts** (`lift_claims` arms + `lift_foreign` wiring): each format
  parses the committed `fixtures/foreign/<format>/` sample (`stand-in`
  provenance, upstream schema cited per directory) and mints the claims its
  own vocabulary names — `swebench.instance:*{model,patch_digest}`,
  `inspect.{version,status,task,model,sample:*,score:*}`,
  `intoto.{subject:*,predicate:*,signature:*{present_unverified}}`,
  `otel.{service:*,trace:*,span_count}` — all under the import-minted
  `unverified` provenance; foreign names ride `name_bindings` (R-ID-4);
  foreign documents parse via `parse_provider` so float lexemes (Inspect
  metrics, OTLP values) lift verbatim rather than dropping the document.
- **Four export arms** (`export_arm` + `export_target` dispatch):
  `predictions.jsonl` (patch from recorded payload fields else `""` — the
  schema's skip marker — with `no_slot` loss, never a fabricated diff);
  `eval_log.json` (scores only from real `verification.validator.verdict` /
  `measurement.metric.emitted` events); `attestation.intoto.jsonl`
  (**unsigned** — `signatures: []` + the named asymmetry loss; signing is
  `attest()`'s claim); `traces.json` (one OTLP span per ledger event,
  deterministic digest-derived ids). Every unshipped member lands a
  `no_slot`/`narrowed`/`untyped_slot` loss row (CC3).
- **Byte-stable round-trips**: each symmetric artefact ships
  `manifest.json` + `digests.json`; re-import preserves every file as a
  `foreign:<path>` member at equal content address with zero digest
  conflicts.
- **Records**: DF-S4.2-2 → DONE; BL-32 landing note (stays open on
  DF-S4.2-1); COVERAGE_MATRIX dated progress on R-2.9.3/R-2.10.3/R-2.10.5
  (verdicts unchanged — R4.16 accounting); ADR-trigger dispositions in
  `docs/build/reports/2026-10-22-adr-0292-0293-0294-0308-trigger.md`
  (0292/0294/0308 not-fired; 0293 ruling 7's DF-S4.2-2 discharged, ruling
  4's DF-S4.2-1 stays open); ADR index regenerated.
